Suspendeddevicewait uncharged; resumedcallbackfreshreservation. Relaxed concurrentplacementreads approximate, notlinearizableminimum.
cost_model.controls: baresteal noreservationorclock; clockonly RRsteal clockswithoutmodel/account; observeonly RRsteal learns+accountswithoutweightedplacement. Fixed/twochoice no callbackclock.
